# CSP Policy Check

> Free tool: paste a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag, see its weaknesses ('unsafe-inline' with no nonce, wildcard or data: script sources, missing object-src and base-uri, 'strict-dynamic' with no nonce, misspelt and duplicate directives), and test whether a script URL, inline script, event handler, style or eval() would be allowed under the W3C CSP Level 3 rules. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded. A Node CLI (`node cli.mjs`) does the same and exits 1 on a high finding or a blocked test.

Free and open source (MIT). Findings describe the policy text, not a security assessment of a site; not security, legal or professional advice.
